title: A Crack in Time
note: Numbers recovered from the decrypted EBOOT.elf by tools/survey/jobbin_scan.py (marker 0xC0DEC0DE), ppu_static.py (calls, TOC slots) and spu_pm_entry.py. The two job modules are ELF32 SPU executables in EBOOT data (PT_LOAD at LS 0x4000, file offset +0x80 of the ELF); the module image starts at the PT_LOAD, 0x20 bytes before the marker. lift_size = that PT_LOAD's file size (header +0x14 footprint minus 0x20, the same relation ToD's registered size has to its footprint; ASSUMPTION that this is the size the title registers). No registration call was resolved: the modules are not referenced through TOC slots (ppu_static.py images: 0 base references).
